ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure utb_to_utrs is
 temp_test_seq_no number;
 v_local_time date;
 v_local_date date;

--
 cursor c1 is
 select test_id, test_seq_no,
 test_state, test_mode,
 result_status_1, result_status_2,
 tb_id, test_chapter_id, tb_seq_no,
 well_number, absorbance, ratio, result_dats,
 result_user_id, testing_lab_code, cancel_flag
 from unit_test_base
 where unit_id = :units.unit_id and
 test_chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 tb_id is not null and
 result_status_1 is not null and
 result_status_2 is null and
 cancel_flag is null
 order by test_id, test_seq_no;
--
 /* This function is added on 04/04/2000 */
 Function move_into_utrs(pl_cnt_id varchar2, pl_test_id varchar2) return boolean is
 v_count Number:=0;
 v_auto_sch Number:=0;
 v_local_time date;
 v_local_date date;

 begin
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 v_local_date := v_local_time;
 else
 v_local_date := sysdate;
 end if;
 
 Select count(*) into v_count from contract_tests where contract_id=pl_cnt_id and test_id=pl_test_id
 and chapter_id=:global.chapter_id and v_local_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date,v_local_date+10);
 If v_count > 0 then
 return TRUE;
 Else
 Select nvl(count(*),0) into v_auto_sch from valid_tests where test_id=pl_test_id and 
 auto_schedule='Y';
 if v_auto_sch > 0 then
 return TRUE;
 else
 return FALSE;
 end if;
 End if;
 RETURN NULL; End move_into_utrs; 
BEGIN

 begin
--
-- it is possible that interdictions were created
-- from test results at a time when the unit was not
-- checked-in at all. In such cases, the chapter_id and
-- coll_date are going to be null in unit_interdictions.
-- This is updated the first unit is checked
-- in from any source. There is an inherent
-- bug here as units from different chapters might
-- actually get the same chapter_id.
--
 update unit_interdictions
 set chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 coll_date = :control_block.coll_date,
 program_id = :banner.prog_name
 where unit_id = :units.unit_id and
 (chapter_id is null or coll_date is null);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in updating unit interdictions');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
--
 begin
--
-- it is possible that tests were created in utrs
-- at a time when the unit was not checked-in at all,
-- specially for antigens. In such cases, the chapter_id and
-- coll_date are going to be null in utrs.
-- This is updated when the first unit is checked
-- in from any source. There is an inherent
-- bug here as units from different chapters might
-- actually get the same chapter_id.
--
 update utrs
 set chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 coll_date = :control_block.coll_date,
 program_id = :banner.prog_name
 where unit_id = :units.unit_id and
 (chapter_id is null or coll_date is null);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message
 ('Error in updating utrs - coll_date/chapter_id is null');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
--
 begin
--
-- it is possible that attributes were created
-- from test results at a time when the unit was not
-- checked-in at all. In such cases, the chapter_id and
-- coll_date are going to be null in unit_attributes.
-- This is updated the first unit is checked
-- in from any source. There is an inherent
-- bug here as units from different chapters might
-- actually get the same chapter_id.
--
 update unit_attributes
 set chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 coll_date = :control_block.coll_date,
 program_id = :banner.prog_name
 where unit_id = :units.unit_id and
 (chapter_id is null or coll_date is null);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in updating unit attributes');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;

-- The following block moves transactions from utb to utrs
-- The sequence of utr activity is as follows:
-- 1. Insert transcations in utr from profile tests
-- 2. Update results from utb to utrs as present.
-- 3. Transfer all reconciled tests from UTB to UTR(as left in UTB)
--
--
-- Step .1.
--
 insert_utrs;
--
-- Step .2.
--
 begin
 for c1_rec in c1
 loop
 begin
 select min(test_seq_no)
 into temp_test_seq_no
 from utrs
 where unit_id = :units.unit_id 
 and trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:control_block.coll_date) 
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id 
 and test_id = c1_rec.test_id 
 and result_status_1 is null 
 and cancel_flag is null;
 if nvl(temp_test_seq_no,0) >= 1
 then
 begin
 update utrs
 set test_state = c1_rec.test_state,
 test_mode = c1_rec.test_mode,
 result_status_1 = c1_rec.result_status_1,

 for this contract in the valid_collection_agencies table.
 If the given unit is a Code 128 unit and if it passes any of the above two checks then
 accept os_unit_id to be the same as an internal Code 128 unit, else raise an error. */ 

FUNCTION CHECK_UNIT_ID 
RETURN boolean
IS
 temp_v_coll_id varchar2(5) := NULL; 
 temp_v_barcd varchar2(1) := NULL;
 v_local_time date;
 v_local_date date;


BEGIN
 
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 v_local_date := v_local_time;
 else
 v_local_date := sysdate;
 end if;
 
 BEGIN
 SELECT coll_id
 INTO temp_v_coll_id
 FROM valid_collection_agencies
 WHERE chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND contract_id = :control_block.contract_id
 AND v_local_date BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date,v_local_date+365);
 EXCEPTION
 when NO_DATA_FOUND then
 BEGIN
 SELECT bar_code_protocol 
 INTO temp_v_barcd
 FROM contracts
 WHERE chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND contract_id = :control_block.contract_id;
 EXCEPTION 
 when NO_DATA_FOUND then
 NULL;
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure; 
 END;
 BEGIN
 IF ((:GLOBAL.code_scheme = 'I') AND (temp_v_coll_id is not null OR temp_v_barcd
 is not null))
 THEN
 return(true);
 ELSIF ((:GLOBAL.code_scheme = 'C') AND (temp_v_coll_id is null OR temp_v_barcd
 is null))
 THEN
 return(true);
 END IF;
 return(false); 
 END;
RETURN NULL; END;
